title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 199 (Effect of ratifying unauthorized act forming part of a transaction)

content.overview: Section 199 provides that a person ratifying any unauthorized act done on his behalf ratifies the whole of the transaction of which such act formed a part.
content.glance: A person ratifying any unauthorized act done on his behalf ratifies the whole of the transaction of which such act formed a part.
content.study: A person ratifying any unauthorized act done on his behalf ratifies the whole of the transaction of which such act formed a part. Current-law framing: ratification of part of a transaction is ratification of the whole.

sections.heading: Core rule
sections.body: A person ratifying any unauthorized act done on his behalf ratifies the whole of the transaction of which such act formed a part.

examples.title: Ratification of whole transaction
examples.body: Ratifying one unauthorized act that forms part of a transaction ratifies the whole transaction under Section 199.

hypotheticals.question: A person ratifies an unauthorized act that forms part of a larger transaction. What is the effect?
hypotheticals.analysis: He ratifies the whole of the transaction of which such act formed a part, under Section 199.

essentialIngredients: That act formed part of a transaction
enhancement.detailedExplanation: Section 199 provides that a person ratifying any unauthorized act done on his behalf ratifies the whole of the transaction of which such act formed a part. Partial ratification of a single transaction is not permitted.
examples: Ratifying one step of an unauthorized transaction ratifies the entire transaction.
distinctions: Limits the ability to ratify selectively within a single transaction.
problemApplication: Identify the unauthorized act and the transaction of which it formed a part.
Conclude that the whole transaction is ratified under Section 199.
keyTakeaways: Ratification of an unauthorized act ratifies the whole transaction of which it formed a part.
